summary: Tripo AI grants 2,000 free OpenAPI credits (~$20 at $0.01/credit) once per account the first time an API key is generated, per its official OpenAPI launch announcement. Credits pay for image and 3D-model generation tasks. Note: Tripo API V2 is unmaintained from 2026-10-01 and retired 2026-11-01; a V2→V3 migration guide is published.
claim_steps: Create an account at https://platform.tripo3d.ai (no card required).
Open the API Keys page and generate a key — 2,000 free credits are granted on first key generation.
Call https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/openapi/task with the key as a Bearer token.

social_proof.title: Pricing | Tripo OpenAPI docs
social_proof.text: The Tripo API pricing is based on credits. ... $1.00 = 100 credits. Notice: From November 1, 2026, Tripo API V2 will be officially retired, and all V2 endpoints will stop serving requests.
